decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.

Condition : 3 - No new doors are to be installed within the building until detailed, scaled drawings of the new doors and their surrounds at a scale of 1:20, which show that all the profiles are exact copies of those original doors elsewhere in the house have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 4 - Unless it can be proven through historical planning or other records that the doorways into the bathroom at second floor level and study at first floor level are not original doorways, then a method of marking those original doorways should be submitted to an approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Condition : 5 - Further details, in the form of plans at 1:50 or 1:100 scale, of all newly located internal plumbing, drainage, and pipework for the first floor study conversion to a bathroom shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of these specific works and shall be installed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - No works to the existing fireplace within 'bedroom 3' as shown on the submitted plans shall take place until full details of the proposed replacement fireplace including 1:20 scale plans and a trade brochure or material sample have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The works shall be implemented in strict accordance with the agreed details and maintained as such thereafter.
description: Internal and external alterations to the existing dwelling house, including the introduction of four conservation style rooflights in the side roof slope and alterations to the first floor and top floor of the property
